name: Content Within Safe Zone
description: All content must stay within safe margins, with no element touching or bleeding past the container/viewport edge
instruction: Check that every element (text, image, card) maintains adequate clearance from all container and viewport edges. Flag anything that touches, clips, or bleeds past an edge unintentionally.
example_pass: [hero section with consistent margin on all sides at every viewport]
example_fail: [card content touching the right edge of its container at mobile width]

name: Grid & Column Alignment
description: Elements must align to a consistent grid/column system across the page
instruction: Check that columns, cards, and content blocks align to a shared grid. Flag any element that sits off-grid or misaligned relative to siblings in the same row/section.
example_pass: [three feature cards aligned to the same top and left edges]
example_fail: [one card in a row shifted slightly left of the others]

name: Visual Hierarchy Flow
description: Layout must guide the eye in the intended order: headline → supporting content → call to action
instruction: Evaluate the scanning order of each section. Flag any layout where a secondary element (e.g. a CTA or image) visually competes with or precedes the primary headline in reading order.
example_pass: [section where the eye flows naturally from headline to visual to CTA]
example_fail: [CTA button styled more prominently than the headline above it]

name: No Element Overlap
description: No two elements should overlap or clip each other unintentionally
instruction: Check for unintended overlapping of text, images, or containers, including z-index stacking issues. Flag any element that visually collides with another.
example_pass: [all text and image elements fully separated with clear spacing]
example_fail: [caption text overlapping the bottom of an image it describes]

name: Spacing Token/Scale Adherence
description: All margin, padding, and gap values must come from the defined spacing scale — no arbitrary off-scale pixel values
instruction: Inspect margin, padding, and gap values across the page. Flag any value that does not match one of the defined spacing tokens/scale steps (e.g. an arbitrary 13px gap when the scale only defines 8/16/24/32).
example_pass: [card padding matching the 16px spacing token used elsewhere]
example_fail: [one component using an arbitrary 22px padding not present in the spacing scale]

name: Section Vertical Rhythm
description: Vertical spacing between major sections must follow a consistent rhythm down the page
instruction: Measure the vertical gap between each major section and the next. Flag any section-to-section gap that is noticeably tighter or looser than the established rhythm elsewhere on the page.
example_pass: [all sections separated by the same vertical spacing throughout the page]
example_fail: [the gap before the footer noticeably smaller than the gaps between other sections]

name: Component Internal Padding
description: Internal padding within components (cards, buttons, inputs, modals) must match the defined padding tokens for that component type
instruction: Check the internal padding of each component instance against the padding defined for that component type. Flag any instance with noticeably more or less internal padding than other instances of the same component.
example_pass: [every card in a grid using identical internal padding]
example_fail: [one card in a grid rendered with tighter internal padding than its siblings]

name: Consistent Gaps Within Groups
description: Gaps between repeated items in the same group (list items, grid items, icon+label pairs) must be uniform
instruction: Measure the gap between consecutive items within the same list, grid, or repeated group. Flag any gap that differs from the others in that same group.
example_pass: [all icons in a feature list spaced evenly from their labels]
example_fail: [one icon in a feature list sitting closer to its label than the others]

name: Symmetric Padding/Margin
description: Padding and margin around content must be symmetric (equal left/right, equal top/bottom) unless an asymmetric layout is explicitly intended
instruction: Check the padding/margin on each side of a container. Flag any container with unequal left/right or top/bottom spacing that appears unintentional rather than a deliberate design choice.
example_pass: [modal content centered with equal padding on left and right]
example_fail: [a card with noticeably more padding on its left side than its right]

name: No Cramped Elements
description: No two elements should sit closer together than the minimum defined spacing, producing a visually cramped result
instruction: Check the distance between adjacent elements, especially text near icons, buttons near each other, and text near container edges. Flag any pair of elements closer than the minimum spacing rule allows.
example_pass: [button and helper text below it separated by adequate breathing room]
example_fail: [a checkbox label text nearly touching the checkbox itself]

name: Spacing Scales Across Breakpoints
description: Spacing values must adapt sensibly across breakpoints — not stay fixed in a way that causes cramping on mobile or excessive gaps on desktop
instruction: Compare spacing at mobile, tablet, and desktop breakpoints. Flag any spacing value that was clearly tuned for one breakpoint and left unchanged, causing cramping on mobile or oversized gaps on desktop.
example_pass: [section padding reducing appropriately from desktop to mobile]
example_fail: [a 120px section padding carried over unchanged to mobile, pushing content off the first screen]

name: Button Label Padding
description: Buttons must have adequate horizontal and vertical padding around their label text, with no text touching the button edge
instruction: Check the padding between button label text and the button's edges on every button and at every breakpoint. Flag any button where the label text touches or nearly touches the button border.
example_pass: [button label centered with clear padding on all sides]
example_fail: [a translated/longer button label touching the left and right edges of the button]

name: Breakpoint Layout Integrity
description: Layout must adapt correctly at every defined breakpoint (mobile, tablet, desktop)
instruction: Render the page at each defined breakpoint and check that the layout reflows correctly — no broken grids, collapsed columns, or misplaced elements. Flag any breakpoint where the layout visibly breaks.
example_pass: [3-column grid collapsing cleanly to 1 column at mobile width]
example_fail: [grid columns overlapping instead of stacking at mobile width]

name: No Unintended Horizontal Scroll
description: The page must not produce horizontal scroll or overflow at any viewport width
instruction: Check the full width of the page at each viewport size. Flag any element that extends beyond the viewport causing horizontal scroll or a visible overflow gap.
example_pass: [page fits fully within viewport width with no scrollbar]
example_fail: [wide table forcing horizontal scroll on mobile]

name: Minimum Touch Target Size
description: Interactive elements must meet a minimum touch target size on mobile/touch viewports
instruction: Check the tappable size of buttons, links, and form controls at mobile width. Flag any interactive element smaller than roughly 44x44px or with insufficient spacing from neighboring targets.
example_pass: [mobile nav icons sized and spaced for easy tapping]
example_fail: [two icon buttons placed edge-to-edge with no tap spacing on mobile]

name: Text Reflow Without Truncation
description: Text must reflow naturally at narrower viewports without truncation, clipping, or overlap
instruction: Check headline and body text at each breakpoint. Flag any text that gets clipped, overlaps an adjacent element, or is cut off with unintended truncation as the viewport narrows.
example_pass: [headline wrapping to two lines cleanly on mobile]
example_fail: [headline clipped with a hidden overflow at mobile width]

name: Approved Font Family Only
description: Only the approved font family/families must be used across all text — no fallback or system font leakage
instruction: Check every text element for the correct font family. Flag any element rendering in a system fallback font, indicating a failed font load or an incorrect override.
example_pass: [all text rendered in the approved brand typeface]
example_fail: [body text falling back to a generic system serif font]

name: Type Scale Consistency
description: Heading, body, and label sizes must follow a single consistent type scale throughout the page
instruction: Compare font sizes for each text role (h1, h2, body, caption, etc.) across sections. Flag any instance where the same role is sized inconsistently in different parts of the page.
example_pass: [all h2 headings across sections sharing the same size and weight]
example_fail: [one section's h2 rendered noticeably smaller than h2s elsewhere on the page]

name: No Orphans or Widows
description: Headlines and short paragraphs must avoid awkward single-word line breaks (orphans/widows)
instruction: Check headline and short-paragraph line breaks. Flag any line break that leaves a single short word alone on the last line, especially in headlines.
example_pass: [headline breaking into two balanced lines]
example_fail: [headline leaving a single word stranded alone on the final line]

name: No Unintended Text Truncation
description: No text should be unexpectedly cut off, clipped, or hidden by overflow
instruction: Check all text containers for overflow: hidden or fixed-height clipping. Flag any text that is cut short with no ellipsis or visual indication, or any ellipsis appearing where full text was intended.
example_pass: [card description fully visible within its container]
example_fail: [card description cut off mid-sentence with no ellipsis or 'read more' affordance]

name: No Placeholder Copy Remaining
description: No lorem ipsum, dummy copy, or placeholder text should remain in the final build
instruction: Scan all text content on the page. Flag any lorem ipsum, 'TODO', 'lorem', bracketed placeholder text (e.g. '[headline here]'), or obviously unfinished copy.
example_pass: [all sections containing final, reviewed copy]
example_fail: [a testimonial section still showing 'Lorem ipsum dolor sit amet']

name: Text/Background Contrast Ratio
description: Text must meet WCAG AA minimum contrast ratio against its background (4.5:1 for body, 3:1 for large text)
instruction: Measure the contrast ratio between every text element and its background. Flag any combination falling below the WCAG AA threshold for its text size.
example_pass: [body text with a contrast ratio above 4.5:1 against its background]
example_fail: [light gray text on a white background failing the minimum contrast ratio]

name: Brand Color Accuracy
description: Brand colors used on the page must match the defined palette/tokens exactly, with no unapproved substitutes
instruction: Compare all colors used against the approved brand palette. Flag any color that is a near-miss, unapproved shade, or substitution not present in the defined palette.
example_pass: [primary CTA using the exact approved brand color]
example_fail: [CTA button using a similar but off-palette shade of purple]

name: Interactive State Color Consistency
description: Hover, active, focus, and disabled states must use consistent, clearly distinguishable colors across all interactive elements
instruction: Check hover/active/focus/disabled styling on buttons, links, and inputs. Flag any element where the state change is missing, inconsistent with similar elements, or too subtle to notice.
example_pass: [all primary buttons darkening consistently on hover]
example_fail: [one button showing no visible change on hover while others do]

name: Image Resolution & Sharpness
description: Images must not appear blurry, pixelated, or visibly upscaled beyond their source resolution
instruction: Inspect every image at its rendered size. Flag any image showing visible pixelation, blur, or compression artifacts, especially when displayed larger than its native resolution.
example_pass: [hero image rendering sharp and clear at full width]
example_fail: [thumbnail image upscaled and appearing visibly pixelated]

name: Descriptive Alt Text Present
description: All meaningful images must have descriptive alt text; decorative images must be marked appropriately
instruction: Check the alt attribute of every image. Flag any meaningful image with missing, empty, or generic alt text (e.g. 'image123.png'), and flag decorative images missing an empty alt/aria-hidden treatment.
example_pass: [product screenshot with alt text describing what it shows]
example_fail: [team photo with alt text left as the raw filename]

name: Image Aspect Ratio Integrity
description: Images must maintain their correct aspect ratio — no stretching, squashing, or distortion
instruction: Compare each image's rendered proportions against its source aspect ratio. Flag any image that appears stretched horizontally or vertically to fit its container.
example_pass: [avatar image rendering as a perfect circle with no distortion]
example_fail: [banner image stretched vertically to fill a taller container than intended]

name: Icon Style Consistency
description: Icons used throughout the page must share a consistent visual style, weight, and size within the same context
instruction: Compare icons used across the page (line weight, fill vs. outline, corner style). Flag any icon that visually clashes with the rest of the icon set.
example_pass: [all feature-list icons sharing the same outline weight and size]
example_fail: [one icon in a filled style while all others in the same list are outlined]

name: Reuse Existing Design System Component
description: Before building any new UI element, the design system's component library must be checked for an equivalent, reusable component already available in code
instruction: Before implementing any element from the design, search the design system's existing component catalog/codebase for a component that already covers the same purpose, variant, and props. Flag any element built as new or custom code when an equivalent component already exists and could be imported and reused as-is.
example_pass: [a CTA implemented by importing the existing Button component with matching props instead of writing a new one]
example_fail: [a new custom button/card/tag element built from scratch in code, duplicating a component that already exists in the design system]

name: Navigation Links & CTAs Valid
description: All navigation links and CTA buttons must point to a valid, working destination
instruction: Check every link and CTA on the page. Flag any link pointing to a placeholder ('#'), a broken URL, or the wrong destination for its label.
example_pass: [every nav item and CTA linking to its correct, live destination]
example_fail: [a 'Get Started' CTA still linking to '#' with no real destination set]

name: Visible Interactive States
description: All interactive elements must have a visible hover and focus state
instruction: Tab through and hover over every interactive element. Flag any button, link, or form control with no visible change on hover or keyboard focus.
example_pass: [button showing a clear visual change on hover and a visible focus ring on keyboard tab]
example_fail: [link showing no visible change on hover or focus, giving no feedback that it's interactive]

name: Form Validation Feedback
description: Forms must show clear, immediate validation and error feedback for invalid input
instruction: Submit forms with invalid and missing input. Flag any form that fails silently, shows no error message, or gives unclear feedback about what needs to be corrected.
example_pass: [email field showing a clear inline error when an invalid address is entered]
example_fail: [required field left blank on submit with no error message shown]

name: Full Keyboard Navigability
description: All interactive elements must be reachable and operable using only the keyboard
instruction: Tab through the entire page using only the keyboard. Flag any interactive element that cannot be reached, has no visible focus indicator, or cannot be activated without a mouse.
example_pass: [every nav link, button, and form field reachable in a logical tab order]
example_fail: [a custom dropdown that cannot be opened or navigated via keyboard]

name: Semantic Heading Structure
description: The page must use a single h1 and a logical, non-skipping heading hierarchy (h1 → h2 → h3)
instruction: Check the document outline for heading tags. Flag any page with more than one h1, headings used purely for visual size rather than structure, or a heading level skipped (e.g. h2 straight to h4).
example_pass: [page with one h1 and section headings following h2, h3 in order]
example_fail: [page using three separate h1 tags for stylistic emphasis]

name: Image Weight Optimization
description: Images must be compressed and served in an appropriately sized/optimized format for web delivery
instruction: Check image file sizes and formats relative to their rendered dimensions. Flag any image that is uncompressed, unnecessarily large in file size, or served far larger than its display size.
example_pass: [hero image served as an optimized WebP sized to its display dimensions]
example_fail: [a 4000px-wide unoptimized PNG displayed at 400px width]

name: No Unexpected Layout Shift
description: Page elements must not shift position noticeably as content and images finish loading
instruction: Load the page and observe element positions before and after all assets finish loading. Flag any visible shift caused by images or fonts loading without reserved space.
example_pass: [image loading into a pre-sized container with no layout shift]
example_fail: [text jumping downward once a hero image without reserved dimensions finishes loading]

name: Core Meta Tags Present
description: Every page must have a title tag, meta description, and Open Graph tags
instruction: Check the page head for a unique title tag, a meta description, and Open Graph (og:title, og:description, og:image) tags. Flag any missing or default/placeholder value.
example_pass: [page with a descriptive title tag and complete Open Graph tags]
example_fail: [page title left as the default 'Untitled Document']

name: SEO-Friendly Heading Order
description: Heading tags must follow a logical order that reflects content structure for search crawlability
instruction: Review the heading tag sequence for logical topical structure, independent of visual styling. Flag any heading order that would confuse a search crawler's understanding of page structure.
example_pass: [headings following a clear topic → subtopic nesting matching the visual layout]
example_fail: [a heading hierarchy where h3 subsection titles appear before their parent h2]

name: Fluid Sizing Over Fixed Width
description: Elements must use max-width plus fluid width rather than a hard-coded fixed pixel width, so they shrink gracefully at narrower viewports
instruction: Check containers, cards, and media for hard-coded fixed widths. Flag any element sized with a fixed pixel width instead of a max-width + fluid width pattern, especially where it could overflow at a narrower viewport.
example_pass: [a card capped with a max-width and full fluid width, shrinking cleanly on narrow screens]
example_fail: [a card fixed at a set pixel width, overflowing its container at a narrower viewport]

name: Actions Full-Width on Mobile
description: Primary and secondary action buttons must expand to full width on mobile rather than remaining at their inline/intrinsic size
instruction: Check CTA and action buttons at mobile width. Flag any primary or secondary action rendering at a small intrinsic width with empty space beside it, when the design intends full-width mobile actions.
example_pass: [a primary action button spanning the full content width on mobile]
example_fail: [a CTA button on mobile rendering at its small intrinsic width, leaving empty space beside it]

name: Repeated Item Rows Must Wrap
description: Rows of repeated items (tags, logos, cards, checkboxes) must wrap to a new line rather than overflowing or being forced onto a single row
instruction: Check any row of repeated items against the container width, accounting for item width and gaps. Flag any row that overflows its container instead of wrapping, or that has been forced onto one line via nowrap.
example_pass: [a row of logos wrapping to a second line once they no longer fit in one row]
example_fail: [a row of tags forced onto a single line, overflowing past the container edge]

name: Layout Holds at Intermediate Widths
description: Layout must remain correct not only at the defined breakpoints but at the widths in between them
instruction: Check the layout at widths between the defined breakpoints, not only at the exact breakpoint values or viewport extremes. Flag any in-between width where proportions look cramped, overlapping, or awkward even though both breakpoints look fine.
example_pass: [layout holding correct proportions at a width midway between two defined breakpoints]
example_fail: [content overlapping only at an in-between width that was never checked, even though both breakpoints looked correct]

name: Granular Responsive Visibility
description: Show/hide behavior across breakpoints must target only the specific element that should change, not an entire parent container
instruction: Compare which elements appear or disappear between breakpoints. Flag any case where hiding one element also hides unrelated sibling content because the visibility rule was applied too broadly to a shared parent.
example_pass: [only a decorative background graphic hidden on mobile, while its sibling content remains visible]
example_fail: [an entire card hidden on mobile because a visibility rule was applied to its parent instead of just the decorative element inside it]

name: Disclosure Widgets Expose State
description: Expandable or collapsible UI (menus, drawers, accordions) must expose their open/closed state via ARIA attributes
instruction: Check every toggleable disclosure element (mobile menu, accordion, dropdown, drawer). Flag any control missing an aria-expanded attribute, or where the value doesn't update when the element opens and closes.
example_pass: [a mobile menu button with aria-expanded toggling between true and false as it opens and closes]
example_fail: [a drawer toggle button with no aria-expanded attribute, giving screen reader users no indication of its state]

name: Media Containers Size to Content
description: Containers holding images or decorative graphics must let the natural aspect ratio determine height rather than forcing a fixed or stretched height
instruction: Check containers wrapping images, illustrations, or decorative shapes. Flag any container with a forced fixed height or aspect-ratio override that causes its content to stretch, crop, or leave unnatural empty space.
example_pass: [an illustration's container sized automatically to match the illustration's natural proportions]
example_fail: [a decorative graphic squashed to fit a container height that doesn't match its natural aspect ratio]
